descriptions.earrings-akoya-hanadama-8.0mm: certified hanadama luster in its most versatile form — set in 18K gold with a mirror-bright shine, made for effortless, everyday radiance.
descriptions.akoya-earrings-hanadama85: a touch more presence, never overstated. at 8.5mm, these hanadama-certified studs carry exceptional luster and roundness — the piece you'll reach for every morning.
descriptions.akoya-earrings-diana: a diamond-set halo that doubles the pearl's radiance — effortlessly elegant for everyday wear, and refined enough for the most special occasions.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-diana-8.5mm: the pearl's soft luster set against diamonds, in a size that commands quiet attention. whether a gift to yourself or to someone extraordinary, this is the choice that never disappoints.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-flower: an ethereal drop earring that sways gracefully with every step. diamond-set petals lend the pearl an added spirit — understated, yet quietly unique.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-tie: for a touch of playful charm — a versatile stud that suits everything from a crisp shirt to a simple tee, effortlessly elegant either way.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-loveshaped: heart-shaped settings bring a playful charm, tempered by the cool elegance of silver-blue akoya pearls — a quietly distinctive piece that reveals an unexpected side of you.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose: for those who want to stand apart — the silver-blue hue of the blue rose akoya speaks entirely for itself, versatile enough to follow your every mood.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose-diana: for those already devoted to the diana setting and seeking something rarer still — the silver-blue akoya elevates it into a truly one-of-a-kind piece.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-diamnond-drop: if refinement is what you seek, this is it — a lustrous akoya pearl cascading from three diamonds, catching the light with every movement. the earring that makes an impression at first glance.
descriptions.earrings-akoya-bluerose-drop: the rare blue rose akoya, now in motion. a single diamond cradles the pearl as it sways gently — rarity and grace, brought together in one earring.
descriptions.earclip-8.0mm: beautiful pearls should never require pierced ears. tested for all-day comfort, this ear clip pairs a finely crafted japanese spiral clasp with a lustrous, softly rosy akoya pearl — every bit as radiant.
descriptions.earclip-bluerose: beautiful pearls should never require pierced ears. tested for all-day comfort, this ear clip pairs a finely crafted japanese spiral clasp with the rare silver-blue akoya — every bit as radiant.
descriptions.earclip-hanadama-8.5mm: beautiful pearls should never require pierced ears. tested for all-day comfort, this ear clip pairs a finely crafted japanese spiral clasp with an exceptional hanadama akoya pearl — every bit as radiant.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-wg-diana: the classic diana setting, reimagined as a pendant — equally versatile with a simple tee or a tailored shirt. the first piece you'll reach for whenever you want to feel your best.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-classic: sometimes, less truly is more. a single pearl on a delicate gold chain, allowing the akoya's natural beauty to speak for itself — effortless with anything in your wardrobe, made for those who love simplicity.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-mermaid: one of our most beloved pieces — a pearl that falls like a mermaid's tear, catching the light against a smaller pearl above. refined, distinctive, and made for someone entirely her own.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-star: gold chain and pearl shine together in this versatile stellar necklace — beautiful with an open neckline, as if wearing the stars themselves. for those who love to catch the light.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-5.5mm: 5.5mm strikes the perfect balance — understated, yet unmistakably present. beautiful with a dress or a simple shirt, and even more striking layered with other necklaces.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-7.5mm: the most classic akoya necklace size — substantial enough to wear alone and make a statement. beautiful with an open neckline, especially in summer, and just as lovely over a simple camisole.
descriptions.necklace-t-akoya-3.5: for those who love a pearl necklace with character — this champagne rose fringe necklace is entirely its own. pearls from 3-6mm create an effortless, ever-so-lovely piece that elevates even the simplest tee.
descriptions.pendant-akoya-y: our most beloved silhouette — the y-chain elongates the neckline and flatters the face beautifully. a single akoya pearl rests at the center, swaying gently with your movement and drawing the eye exactly where it should. the adjustable length allows for several ways to wear it.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-3.5: our summer favorite — an exquisitely refined strand of small akoya pearls. understated luxury worn alone, and effortlessly elevated when layered with other necklaces.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-8.5mm: a single strand that does it all — luminous, full-bodied akoya pearls rivaling any fine jewelry counter. whether for a wedding, a graduation, or any moment that matters, this necklace shines alongside you.
descriptions.necklace-m-akoya-candy-8.0: for anyone who's found pearls a little too formal — this macaron-hued strand brings a playful sweetness to the neckline, without compromising on the quality of a fine akoya pearl. a summer favorite.
descriptions.ring-akoya-5mm: two akoya pearls set side by side on an 18K gold band — modern, versatile, and just distinctive enough to set it apart from the usual single-pearl ring.
descriptions.ring-akoya-ring-3.0mm: a row of small akoya pearls with a soft rosy luster, arcing across the finger like the gentlest smile. delicate, easy to layer, and the kind of ring that lifts your mood each time you wear it.
descriptions.ring-southsea-marine: a south sea pearl paired with a vivid aquamarine, set side by side in polished white gold — two elements of the sea, brought together in one refined silhouette.
descriptions.ring-tahitian: a single tahitian pearl set on a clean, polished band — understated, timeless, and entirely self-assured.
descriptions.ring-southsea-catier: a south sea pearl cradled in a sculptural wave of polished gold — fluid, modern, and quietly striking from every angle.
descriptions.ring-southsea-feather-12.5: a 12.5mm south sea pearl crowned with a spray of diamonds, like frost caught mid-motion — substantial in presence, delicate in detail.
descriptions.ring-akoya-balance: three akoya pearls set in gentle succession across the finger — perfectly balanced, effortlessly elegant, made to be worn every day.
descriptions.ring-keshi: freeform keshi pearls clustered together with delicate diamond accents — organic, sculptural, and entirely one of a kind, like every keshi pearl itself.
descriptions.bracelets-akoya-double: a bracelet rich in design detail — refined japanese 18K gold paired with lustrous akoya pearls, as though stars had scattered across the wrist. a beauty that's yours alone to notice.
descriptions.bracelets-candy: bright, spirited, and beautiful worn any way — this confetti bracelet gathers akoya pearls in every natural hue. wear it alone or layered with a gold or silver chain — a beauty that's yours alone to notice.
descriptions.earrings-p-southsea-11.0mm: a pair of south sea studs to treasure for a lifetime — refined enough to speak for themselves, without a single embellishment. the earrings that draw admiring questions wherever you go: rich in luster, radiant in color, effortlessly elegant.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonex-11mm: lustrous, richly colored south sea studs — near-round pearls that sit perfectly on the ear with a vivid, gem-like shine. accompanied by a japan-certified phoenix-grade certificate, yet effortless enough for everyday wear.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-9.0mm-feather: a designer take on the south sea stud — a warm, lustrous pearl set among diamond feathers. refined enough for daily wear, versatile enough to complement any look.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-drop: simple, refined, and quietly graceful — this south sea drop pairs effortlessly with a crisp white shirt for a clean, polished look. set on a substantial japanese 18K gold ear hook, the quality shows in every detail. classic, and made to last.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonix-12mm: lustrous, richly colored south sea studs with a phoenix-grade certified shine. at 12mm, this pair carries true presence — the confidence-building statement piece you've been looking for.
descriptions.earrings-southsea-pheonix-13mm: lustrous, richly colored south sea studs with a phoenix-grade certified shine, at their most commanding size yet. 13mm is presence without effort — the pair that finishes a room before you say a word.
descriptions.necklace-southsea-8.0-10.0: the south sea strand is the jewelry investment that never loses its worth — a necklace to treasure for a lifetime, and to pass down beyond it. at 8-10mm, it elevates any look, from a simple white tee to a gown. own it once, keep it forever.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-apple: a design both refined and playful — an 18K gold apple set with diamonds, cradling a luminous akoya pearl. unexpected, endearing, and entirely its own.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-flower: a south sea piece to own once and treasure always — a warm, lustrous white pearl paired with a striking gold pearl, framed by a gilded floral setting. the adjustable double-strand length allows for several ways to wear it — a truly distinctive long necklace.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-blue-y: the silver-blue south sea pearl is a rare find, set on a y-chain that elongates the neckline and flatters the face. as you move, the pearl sways gently, drawing the eye exactly where it should.
descriptions.pendant-southsea-rainbow-y: a south sea pearl with natural rainbow overtones is rare in itself — set on a y-chain, its color shifts with every movement. a piece that looks entirely different in every light.
descriptions.bracelets-southsea: the most understated way to wear a south sea pearl. a single pearl on a delicate gold chain — quiet confidence at the wrist. those who truly understand fine jewelry will notice it immediately.
descriptions.earrings-tahitian: tahitian black pearls have a way of drawing a second glance. these 9.0mm classic studs carry that signature deep luster — green, purple, grey — colors no other gem can replicate. for anyone drawn to the mystery of dark pearls.
descriptions.earclip-tahitian: the depth and drama of a 9.0mm tahitian pearl, designed for those without pierced ears. fine jewelry, after all, should belong to everyone.
descriptions.earrings-tahitian-ocenblue: for those who love tahitian pearls and want even more color, ocean blue is the answer. a grey tahitian pearl with a vivid blue overtone, strikingly beautiful in every light. one of the most captivating pieces you'll ever wear.
descriptions.necklace-tahitian: no two multicolor tahitian necklaces are ever alike — that is precisely its beauty. black, grey, green, and peacock pearls, thoughtfully paired to complement one another. a collector's piece that draws admiration every time it's worn.
descriptions.pendant-tahitian-necklace: a single tahitian pearl on a delicate chain — deep, complex, endlessly captivating. for those drawn to depth and mystery rather than the expected.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-diana: the diana setting, reimagined with a south sea keshi pearl. the structured elegance of the classic halo, paired with the organic beauty of keshi — for those devoted to the setting who still want a pearl entirely their own.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-gold: warm, golden, and entirely one of a kind. the gold south sea keshi pearl is a beautiful byproduct of the harvest — each pair subtly unique, and never quite like any other.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-10mm: angular and bold — this prism setting lends a 10mm tahitian keshi pearl a striking geometric edge. for those drawn to dark pearls but seeking a more contemporary expression.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-southsea-drop: freeform south sea keshi pearls as drops — each one shaped entirely by nature, with a luster that rivals the finest round pearls. no two pairs are ever alike, and that is the whole of its beauty.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-12mm: the 12mm tahitian keshi drop is a bold choice — deep, iridescent, entirely its own. for those who want a piece that starts a conversation, this is it.
descriptions.earrings-keshi-tahitian-three: three tahitian keshi pearls cascading in layers — deep, iridescent, each subtly different from the last. effortless to wear, impossible to forget.
descriptions.necklace-akoya-keshi: akoya keshi pearls carry all the luster of fine akoya with the freedom of organic form — each one a small marvel of nature. gathered together in a single strand, they become something truly special.
descriptions.necklace-bluebarouque: baroque south sea pearls in a cool blue-grey are a rare find — organic form and cool tone together create something sculptural rather than merely decorative. for those who truly wish to stand apart.
